NATIONAL FOREWORD
This Indian Standard (Part 1/Section 111) (First Revision) which is identical to IEC 61196-1-111 : 2024 'Coaxial communication cables - Part 1-111: Electrical test methods - Stability of phase test methods' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of Wires, Cables, Waveguides and Accessories Sectional Committee and approval of the Electronics and Information Technology Division Council.
